sources.title: Kryeministri Edi Rama në takimin me strukturat drejtuese të Policisë së Shtetit
sources.supports: Distinction between announced immediate2500euro amount and separate salary rise from1January; no payment verification.

visualMethod: Two qualitative source-linked diagrams: police obligations and practical AMP complaint channels. No quantities are inferred from the clip and no financial calculation is needed.

meaningEvidence: Exact published TikTok clip recovered through the native Download video option and bound by its URL and SHA-256.

Complete Albanian audio transcribed; eight frames spanning0–105s and the original poster visually inspected. Burned Albanian captions support the main reaction to Rama and criticism of policing/protest response.

Eduard speaks outdoors about his reaction to Rama addressing police, financial offers, perceived officer fatigue/injustice and predicted public response. His post caption supplies the conscience metaphor.
limitations: Public clip is political commentary, not evidence of every officer’s beliefs, resources or conduct.
Other comparisons concerning Kosovo politicians, alleged equipment shortages, protest duration and army involvement are not independently established here and are not repeated as facts.
The government transcript establishes an announcement, not execution, entitlement details or a monthly salary of2500euros.
No finding is made about the lawfulness of a specific use of force or the outcome of a complaint.
